Documentation claims are reconciled with actual tools, hosting, SDKs, data, tests and operational behavior.
Objective offline checks and contract probes distinguish implemented/tested from proposed/live-unverified behavior.
Plan preserves complete agent roles and identifies incompatible/unimplemented bindings without silently simplifying scope.
Plan includes Domains V2 observation-only integration, safe identity/network boundaries, bounded operation, quality gates and rollback.
Integrated verification approves research completeness or explicitly identifies unresolved review coverage.
evidencePolicy: Fresh local source and direct offline results; public official sources for current API feasibility; earlier Azure snapshots explicitly historical, not new runtime authorization proof.
residualRiskPolicy: Unimplemented deployment capabilities may remain only as explicit pre-deployment gates. No security, cloud or model-quality acceptance is inferred. User owns future consequential approvals.
toolingBoundary: Foundry auto-setup is not run because it may install extensions; no Foundry execution workflow/sub-skill is entered during read-only source review.
